# Results

## Maps Generated by BelugaSLAM on Different Datasets

All experiments were conducted using KLD-adaptive sampling with a minimum of 5 particles and a maximum of 30 particles.

## Evaluation Tools

Trajectory evaluation was performed using EVO, a Python package for the evaluation of odometry and SLAM algorithms.

Repository: https://github.com/MichaelGrupp/evo
